description: Google Keep notes — Sam's S0 authored signals from mobile. Promoted through sessions.

entries.label: Keep: Cloverleaves + identity + governance
entries.raw_text: Cloverleaves, id of the properties? URN, wires, ports and interfaces, cooperads, others, design structures. TypeID identity is for AuthUser? How about agents? Is this the governance thing? Tied properties. Structures bound to identity.
entries.interpretation: Identity in Cloverleaf topology: type identity is global (ontology.json at hub), instance identity (URNs) is scoped per leaf. AuthUser = type-level; agent = instance. Governance = which leaf owns which identity. Yoneda: structures ARE identity.

entries.label: Keep: Skills as workflow managers
entries.raw_text: Use to produce skills. Skills are workflow managers. The skill isnt use and I produce workflow. Recursive mindmasher. Purpose?
entries.interpretation: Skills = composable morphism programs with declared purpose-state. A skill is a PortFunctor path (FUN12) through BindingCategory space. Recursive = meta-skills are NTs between PortFunctors.

entries.label: Keep: LLM as state transformer, not req/resp
entries.raw_text: LLM does not request response. It IS in a graph and is a state transforming thing. Node helps me in the user graph or admin graph.
entries.interpretation: LLM is a graph node (agnostic_model, S2). Output = proposed morphism sequence, not text. Text = S4 projection. Lives in Inspect (GPU) tier. Operates in user graph (KernelLeaf) or admin graph (KernelHub).
